messages.text: Small red sports car built and approved. 3.96m low wedge coupe in glossy red with black intake/diffuser, raked glasshouse + targa roof, 2-seat cockpit tub with dash and steering wheel, and 4 silver 5-spoke wheels at corners. Showcased in 3/4 hero view.

asset.description: 6.5m blue box truck: cab with open windshield frame, headlights, mirrors, chassis, tall blue cargo box with white logo panels, 6 wheels on 3 axles.

messages.text: 9-second stunt complete: red car speeds from down-street, climbs the ramp, soars over all 5 sideways blue trucks, lands hard past them and skids to a stop. Camera chases from behind then swings high alongside to keep launch, flight, landing and skid in frame.
Direct the camera with three shots: a low tracking shot chasing the car, a wide side view for the jump, and a close-up from the front as it lands and stops.
